stand verb

classical

Traupman 384

stō, stāre

verb, first conjugation

Other words

  • astō (adstō), astāre, astitī — stand by, stand there, stand waiting

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Aul. 528: mīles inprānsus astat, aes cēnset darī; Plaut. Men. 697: etiamne astās?

Examples

  • Iterum stā.

    Stand up again.composed

  • mīles inprānsus astat, aes cēnset darī

    the soldier stands there with no lunch in him and thinks he ought to be paidPlaut. Aul. 528

  • Asta igitur, ut cōnsuētus es puer ōlim.

    Stand still, then, as you used to when you were a boy.Plaut. Asin. 703

See also fall, balance.

SourcesLewis & Short: sto · Lewis & Short: asto

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.

Plautus, Asinaria 703; Aulularia 528; Menaechmi 697.
